    "The free plan's single project limitation can hinder separate workstreams.",

  "overall_experience": "This Personal Assistant likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward tool for its core purpose of centralizing information and facilitating team communication. The clean interface and ease of managing basic tasks were appreciated. However, the limitations of the free plan and some initial setup friction, like manually adding tools and adjusting default settings, presented minor frustrations for a new user in a larger organization."
